desc:
Store content changes and page edits cover the small updates that keep a store current, such as banners, text, prices, photos and menu links. Ecom Swift LLC makes the edits in your own store and checks each one on phone and desktop.

## What are store content changes?

Content changes are edits to what your store says and shows, as opposed to how it is built. They include a new sale banner, a revised product description, a swapped photo, a corrected price, a new menu link or a changed policy paragraph. They need care but not a redesign, and they are easy to put off because each one takes time away from running the business.

## Why small edits deserve attention

A store that looks out of date makes shoppers wonder whether the business is still active. An expired sale banner, a price that differs between two pages or a typo in a headline all weaken trust. Visitors judge quickly, and they judge on small signs.

Doing the edits yourself is possible, but each one comes with traps. A new photo can be too large and slow the page. A pasted paragraph can bring along strange formatting. A banner can look right on a laptop and break on a phone. Having the changes made and checked removes those risks.

## How accurate content helps results

Clear, current content helps shoppers decide. A correct price, honest delivery wording and a working menu remove doubts at the moment a visitor is choosing. Fresh promotional banners direct attention to what you want to sell now.

Search engines also read your text, headings and image descriptions. Consistent wording and descriptive alt text help them understand each page. The effect depends on your wider site, but sloppy or missing text only makes the job harder.

## What good content edits include

- Exact wording and images applied as you supplied them.
- Banner and announcement bar updates.
- Price, compare-at price and sale label changes across products.
- Menu, footer and link updates.
- Text corrections with a spelling and wording check.
- Photo resizing so images stay sharp but load quickly.
- Alt text for every image we add or replace.
- Checks on phone and desktop after each edit.
- Screenshots as proof of each change.
- A consistency pass, so fonts, spacing and tone match across pages.

## What we do

You send a list of changes with the new wording, images and the pages they belong to. We confirm what we have understood, then make each change in your store. After every edit, we view the page on a phone and a desktop screen and take a screenshot for you.

The package sets how many edits are included and what kinds. Basic covers a short list of text, banner and image edits. Standard handles a bigger batch that includes price updates, menu changes and promotional sections. Premium adds new page sections, image preparation and a consistency check across the store. This is an order for a set number of edits within the delivery time. If you want a standing arrangement every month, we quote that separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send the final wording in a document or message, not scattered notes.
- Give image files at full size, with a note about where each goes.
- Say which edits matter most so we can do them first.
- Tell us the dates for any sale, so the banner starts and ends on time.
- Review the screenshots and tell us promptly if anything looks wrong.

**Avoid:**
- Sending small pictures copied from a chat app.
- Changing the wording after we have begun, without telling us.
- Leaving expired banners and prices live after a promotion ends.
- Writing long paragraphs in banners that shoppers will not read.
- Mixing styles, such as three fonts or several button colors on one page.

## Who this is for

This suits a busy owner with a list of small changes and no spare hours. It suits a seller preparing for a seasonal promotion who needs prices, banners and menus updated together. It also suits a business that has a new brand message and wants the store text brought into line.

## What we need from you

A clear list of the edits, with wording, images and page names. We need access as a collaborator, staff or admin user in your own store. We never need your password. If your wording is not final, say so before we begin, so we do not edit the same page twice.
